# Results — Study 185 (Chande-Momentum) on real daily tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). Two framings of the Chande
Momentum Oscillator (CMO, period 14) — overbought/oversold (|CMO| > 50, mean-reversion
bet) and zero-cross (momentum-follow bet) — run on five liquid daily tapes (SPY, QQQ, IWM,
GLD, TLT, 10 years) against a **random-direction control** on the same entry bars, 5-day
forward-return backtest. As-of **2026-06-15**. Pooled trades across the basket.*

## Framing 1 — Overbought/Oversold (mean-reversion bet)

Entry on the *onset* of |CMO(14)| > 50; +1 (buy) when CMO < −50, −1 (short) when CMO > +50.
Trade entered at next open; hold 5 days, exit at close.  Cost = 0 (gross).

| Arm | n trades | win-rate | mean (bps/trade) | HAC *t* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **CMO OB/OS signal** | 546 | 49.8% | **+2.78** | **+0.24** |
| Random direction (control) | 546 | 49.6% | +1.69 | +0.15 |

- Signal delta vs control: **+1.09 bps/trade** — negligible and not statistically significant.
- HAC *t* = **+0.24** on the signal; the bar for "real" is |*t*| ≥ 2 — the signal is deep in
  the noise band.

### OB/OS hold-period sweep (gross, vs random control)

| hold | signal (bps) | HAC *t* | coin (bps) | HAC *t* |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
|  1 d | +0.40 | +0.08 | +1.41 | +0.33 |
|  3 d | +1.72 | +0.19 | +4.03 | +0.48 |
|  5 d | **+2.78** | **+0.24** | +1.69 | +0.15 |
| 10 d | −21.06 | −1.04 | −1.71 | −0.11 |
| 20 d | −16.94 | −0.69 | +8.00 | +0.40 |

No hold period clears the inference bar.  The 10-day signal is *negative* and worse than the
coin, suggesting that at longer horizons the mean-reversion framing may actually hurt.

## Framing 2 — Zero-Cross (momentum-follow bet)

Entry on CMO(14) zero-cross; +1 (buy) on up-cross, −1 (short) on down-cross.
Same trade mechanics as Framing 1.

| Arm | n trades | win-rate | mean (bps/trade) | HAC *t* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **CMO zero-cross signal** | 1,399 | 51.5% | **+0.66** | **+0.14** |
| Random direction (control) | 1,399 | 51.5% | +2.17 | +0.36 |

- Signal delta vs control: **−1.51 bps/trade** — the signal is *worse* than a coin, and
  both arms are statistical noise (|*t*| well below 2).
- HAC *t* = **+0.14** on the signal; no edge.

### Zero-cross hold-period sweep (gross, vs random control)

| hold | signal (bps) | HAC *t* | coin (bps) | HAC *t* |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
|  1 d | −1.59 | −0.61 | +1.46 | +0.66 |
|  3 d | +2.68 | +0.62 | +0.72 | +0.15 |
|  5 d | +0.66 | +0.14 | +2.17 | +0.36 |
| 10 d | +0.75 | +0.13 | +1.06 | +0.11 |
| 20 d | +4.39 | +0.58 | +0.16 | +0.01 |

No hold period clears the inference bar on the zero-cross framing either.

## Cost sweep — OB/OS framing (hold 5d, net)

At a realistic round-trip cost the gross +2.78 bps quickly erodes:

| round-trip cost | net mean (bps/trade) | HAC *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| 0.0 bps (gross) | +2.78 | +0.24 |
| 0.5 bps | +2.28 | +0.19 |
| 1.0 bps | +1.78 | +0.15 |
| 2.0 bps | +0.78 | +0.07 |

The gross is close enough to zero that even a 0.5 bp cost pushes it into statistical
irrelevance; there is no robust break-even analysis to do here.

## Synthetic positive control

On a deterministic synthetic daily tape with planted structure, the same engine recovers
a CMO signal *only* when the matching structure is present:

- OB/OS framing: average (signal − coin) = **+69.9 bps** under mean_rev = 0.40 vs
  **−31.4 bps** on a martingale (averaged across 6 tape seeds, n = 1,000 days each).
- Zero-cross framing: average (signal − coin) = **+86.8 bps** under momentum = 0.40 vs
  **−11.1 bps** on a martingale.

The engine is a faithful structure harvester; the real-tape verdict is about the market.

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** OB/OS pooled gross HAC *t* = +0.24; zero-cross HAC *t* = +0.14. Both
  framings are statistically indistinguishable from a random-direction coin across all hold
  periods tested.  Neither framing clears |*t*| ≥ 2 on any instrument or hold window.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The gross is too close to zero to survive any realistic round-trip
  cost; at 1 bp net mean = +1.78 bps (HAC *t* = +0.15), a coin with a cost attached.
